title: 练习三（2023年）

41.why: The unexpected display makes “我” delighted. 心花怒放 describes that inner joy after “看得我”.

options.en: be delighted; one's heart blooms with joy
options.note: An inner feeling: 看得我心花怒放.
Describes sounds or an atmosphere, not “我”的心理.

options.zh: 心愿得到满足，十分满意
options.note: He is excited by new sights, not yet satisfied after getting what he wants.

options.zh: 非常欢喜，常表现为喜气洋洋的样子
options.note: Close in meaning, but 心花怒放 more directly describes the inner delight here.

42.why: “麻木” contrasts with “这里反而……新鲜感”. The malls feel similar to one another.

options.note: Would emphasise distinct merits, not the similarity that makes him feel numb.
Variety would not explain this contrast as well as similarity.

options.zh: 大体相同，只有小部分差别
options.note: Explains why the usual malls no longer feel fresh.

options.zh: 巧妙、新颖的构思或想法
options.note: Refers to ideas, not how similar the malls' products are.

43.why: The author contrasts this shop's clothes with the showy style of street performers' costumes.

options.zh: 迷惑人的手法；也指花样、招数
options.note: A tactic, not the visual style of the clothes here.

options.zh: 说话重复、繁杂；也指事情麻烦
options.note: Not the intended description of a costume's appearance.
Familiarity belongs to someone's knowledge of something.

options.zh: 超过通常程度；此处指造型抢眼、过于突出
options.note: Here it describes the striking style of performers' costumes.

44.why: He has trouble choosing among styles and fabrics, so he asks a sales assistant to suggest a suitable one.

options.zh: 主动把信息等发送给用户
options.note: Use: 推送消息. Not personal advice on choosing clothes.

options.zh: 把合适的人或事物介绍给别人选择
options.note: Use: 推荐款式. The assistant helps him choose.

options.zh: 看到或找到以前没有注意到的事物
options.note: Finding something is not the same as advising a customer.
Use: 发觉不对劲. Not a shopping recommendation.

45.why: The foreign shoppers appreciate the value of these traditional clothes. 识货 describes people who can judge quality.

options.note: Use: 购货渠道. “选购……购货的老外” would be repetitive and less natural.

options.zh: 能够判断物品的好坏或价值
options.en: know quality when one sees it
options.note: “识货的老外” means buyers who appreciate good items.
Usually describes behaviour or dress, not a buyer's judgement.
Does not explain their appreciation of the clothes.

46.why: “他们……拥抱中华文化” contrasts with the Chinese shoppers' negative attitude towards their own tradition.

options.note: Use: 突破困难. Does not express the rejecting attitude here.
Use: 排斥自己的传统. Opposite to “拥抱” in this context.
Describes coming together, not rejecting.
The object is “自己的传统”, not something foreign.

47.why: He openly and confidently wears the new outfit to visit relatives. 大摇大摆 fits the slightly playful tone.

options.zh: 故意做出样子，显得不真实
options.note: The passage does not say he pretends to be someone else.
Describes physical movement, not his confident manner here.

options.zh: 走路或行动时大模大样，满不在乎
options.en: swagger; act with an unconcerned air
options.note: Here it humorously describes confidently going out in 唐装; not a general praise word.
Use: 一五一十地告诉别人. Does not describe going on a visit.

48.why: His mother's praise makes him pleased with his own choice. 沾沾自喜 means self-satisfaction, not a new discovery.

options.note: He is reacting to praise, not inventing an unrealistic plan.
There is no earlier puzzle being solved here.
Describes something that makes people reflect; not his pleased feeling.

options.zh: 因自己的表现或成就而自我得意
options.note: Often disapproving. Here it is a lightly self-mocking account of his own pride.

49.why: The sentence describes hot weather that makes long sleeves uncomfortable: 天气炎热.

options.note: Use: 热烈欢迎. Describes emotion or atmosphere, not air temperature.

options.zh: 温度很高；也形容感情强烈
options.note: Use: 炽热的阳光、炽热的感情. 炎热 is the more natural everyday description of weather here.
Use: 天气炎热、炎热的夏天.
A noun; the sentence needs a description of the weather.

50.why: Wearing 唐装 helps the tradition carry on over time. 让传统延续下去 expresses this continuity naturally.

options.note: Use: 延长时间. The focus here is keeping a tradition alive.

options.zh: 活动等持续进行，不中断
options.note: Close in meaning, but 延续 more precisely expresses a tradition being carried forward.

options.zh: 连续不断，常形容空间上的延伸
options.note: Often describes mountains or a continuous stretch; not the usual choice for preserving a tradition.

options.zh: 照原来的状态持续下去
options.note: Use: 延续传统. Fits keeping a tradition alive through practice.

paragraphs: 我为了买一件唐装而来到了这间老店。在牛车水一带活动了这些年，一直没踏进这家老店，以为它专卖药材、补品等。没料到店主在过年期间进口许多漂亮的旗袍、唐装、绣花鞋，看得我{41}，像刘姥姥进大观园，对每一件物品充满好奇，大开眼界。
乌节路逛多了，有点麻木，因为每间购物中心的物品{42}。这里反而给我很多新鲜感和视觉上的新刺激。
选购唐装原来不简单，价钱差异相当大。这里的货物有别于街头艺人服装的{43}，也不是迎合洋人旅客口味的类型。试穿不同的款式，我发现布料的质地会影响外观，有的口袋往下垂，有的领口不太挺，最后要劳烦一位售货阿姨为我{44}。
有些朋友很意外，我什么时候变得这么老土，哪有年轻人穿唐装的？
其实不然，我看到店里架子上贴着的杂志广告，是一位金发碧眼男模，穿唐装配牛仔裤，蛮帅气的。当天到这间老店选购唐装的还有很多{45}的老外。但是，为什么他们一窝蜂地拥抱中华文化，而我们华人本身却{46}自己的传统呢？
售货阿姨也有点纳闷地说：“每年过年都有很多人买唐装，平时却不见有人在街上穿……华人好像不喜欢自己的传统服装！”
我就这样穿着新买的唐装，在大年初一{47}地拜年去。没想到，妈妈居然说：“穿唐装很好看啊！”这让我{48}，认定自己做对了。
也许新加坡的天气{49}，不适合经常穿上长袖子的唐装，但有时换上一件唐装，你必定成为众人焦点。能让传统{50}下去，就算是一年就那么几次，又何妨呢？
